item: The launcher stop-row reader skips a line that is not a row instead of raising (reader audit)
summary: Audit of the three launcher-file readers against 33 file shapes (empty, torn, interleaved, NUL, invalid UTF-8, a line that is a number or null or a list, wrong field types, huge values, a 3 MB line, a directory): launcher_exit and launcher_stderr never raised; launcher_stop raised AttributeError on 5 non-object lines and TypeError on an unhashable signal (7 of 99 reader-shape pairs), and launcher_exit calls it when it has no exit row, so one torn line in launcher_stops.jsonl cost forensics its launcher row, its stderr row and the crash trace (they share one try). Now a non-object line is skipped and a signal that is not a string is not a signal; 0 of 99 raise. Pinned by a parametrised test, red without. Audit script and before/after tables: /mnt/project-files/rc-diagnostics/exit-evidence-sweep/reader-audit/.
